title: Mail sent to me as cc: and/or bcc:  (but not as To:) is received at ISP mail server, but Thunderbird will not retrieve.
creator: dave488
content:
Mail sent to me as cc: and/or bcc: addressee (but not as a To: addressee) is received at my ISP mail account, but Thunderbird will not retrieve them.

This has been going for a long while it seems, but I don't get much mail addressed as cc: or bcc:, so I only recently became aware of it.

My ISP webmail interface uses Roundcube. Cc: and bcc: messages sent to me show up there. I have Thunderbird 156.0 installed on two macOS 27.0 machines and Thunderbird 24.0b2 installed on Android 17 (includes all updates through Android security update of September 5, 2026). Neither of the three will retrieve the cc: or bcc: messages, but all other e-mail functions work as expected.

My ISP says it's a Thunderbird problem, but I ain't so sure. Any ideas?

title: Error messages.  t-bird Linux Mint ".p" and "UID Fetch"
creator: davecalder
content:
I have the latest T-bird installed on a latest version linux Mint laptop and occasionally get puzzling errors on Yahoo mail.

Mostly it all works, but Yahoo email errors are often enough to be bothersome and I can't find any information on the rather obsure errors. Been this way through many t-bird and Linux releases.

My other email accounts don't seem to have a problem (gmail, outlook) on any t-bird instances. Just Yahoo mail on Linux Mint t-bird. Here are the errors:

"Please try later" and apparent timeouts on Yahoo mail (on t-bird, of course). This is obvious, but it doesn't happen on my Win 11 and Android T-bird programs.

Operation on yahoo "inbox" did not succeed. Yahoo mail server responded "p." (Yes, just "p.")

Operation on yahoo "inbox" did not succeed. Yahoo mail server responded "UID FETCH completed"

These errors don't seem to happen on Android t-bird or Win 11 t-bird on the same accounts, but I'm not on those for very long.

Any guidance would be appreciated.
